item.title: Trump lands in China for historic meeting with Xi, Putin
item.description: President Donald Trump has landed in Shenzhen for historic trilateral talks with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin.

item.title: Nvidia stock up 3% as earnings beat expectations. Neoclouds surge
item.description: The chip giant's earnings come at a tumultuous time for the company.

item.title: Putin says EU is losing industry, falling behind competition, ahead of meeting with Trump and Xi
item.description: Putin used the speech to emphasize Russia's economic resilience despite U.S. sanctions, and played up opportunities for APEC members in the country.

item.title: Iran says army targets U.S. drone and missile sites in Kuwait as Gulf attacks mount
item.description: Iran said its army targeted U.S. drone and missile installations at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem air base, extending a run of attacks on Gulf states.

item.title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
item.description: The rules require data centers in Southeast Asia to seek U.S. approval to buy advanced AI chips, threatening to slow a build-out fueled heavily on Chinese demand.

item.title: Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6%
item.description: It put the U.K.'s annual inflation rate at a 1-year high.

item.title: Treasury yields hold steady as investors look ahead to Fed minutes
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields were broadly flat on Wednesday, as Wall Street awaits the release of the latest FOMC minutes.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Starshield speed curbs still in place over 'occupied territories' of Ukraine
item.description: Ukraine's charge d'affaires to the U.S., Denys Sienik, said that Starshield had been speed-limited for seven days already in Ukraine.

item.title: Senators press acting U.S. Navy Secretary on Iran war costs, sailor health in confirmation hearing
item.description: Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao told senators the Navy recoded and used munitions he called expired as the Iran war strains weapons stocks and naval deployments.

item.title: South Korea will suspend all aircraft operation for 35 minutes and markets will open late. Here’s why
item.description: South Korea will suspend aircraft takeoffs and landings nationwide for 35 minutes on Thursday to minimize noise during a college entrance exam.

item.title: Japan exports in October surge 20.5%, beating estimates on robust chip shipments
item.description: Semiconductor shipments spiked almost 50% year on year.
